name: What are the maintenance requirements for new sliding glass doors?

mainEntity.name: What are the maintenance requirements for new sliding glass doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern sliding glass doors are designed for low maintenance. Regular cleaning of the glass with a non-abrasive cleaner helps maintain clarity. It's also important to keep the tracks free of dirt, dust, and debris to ensure smooth operation; a vacuum cleaner with a brush attachment works well for this. Periodically, check weatherstripping for wear and lubricate rollers with a silicone-based spray to prevent sticking. Avoid harsh chemicals that could damage frames or seals. Proper maintenance ensures longevity and optimal performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance includes regularly cleaning glass, keeping tracks free of debris, checking weatherstripping, and lubricating rollers with a silicone-based spray.
